source_conclusions.detail: Strict official PV load followed by the original trained G delta, then the unchanged zero-output range head. Only candidate_box_refiner parameters require gradients. model.eval() precedes both training paths and only the independent head is set to train. Comparisons cover the original persistent parameters and buffers, and original gradients must remain None.

The refiner runs after native Mask generation and replaces last_center/last_pred_size before the native criterion. Native bbox and GIoU therefore train the same refined box used for evaluation, with unchanged native weights. Semantic and Mask outputs are frozen observations; no geometry-to-Mask gradient is required or falsely asserted.

Both source conditions preserve the existing 400614 parameters, all 256 candidates, local support and native scalar-alpha logit fusion. The only source intervention is actual 109-D range evidence versus zeros. No teacher, new loss, P2, quality reranking, GT inference gate or dual deployed forward was introduced.

One real sampled B8 is reused for two optimizer updates. The code checks cached source-off/on zero-head equality, native head-off/on equality with reset RNG, task geometry output gradients, second-step member/condition/aggregate gradients, original state equality and BytesIO head/optimizer restoration. The preflight returns before disk checkpoint creation. Controller fields agree with the produced receipt.

training.frozen and training.small_lr are false, so the unchanged native AdamW groups select the 10 head tensors and two empty groups. Formal restoration overlays exactly the head delta onto the strict original G state. Optimizer groups, state keys, steps and moments are compared by the existing restore helper in the planned probe.

The conditional runner preserves one 29778-row pass, B8 with last B2, 3723 updates, seed 2027, LR 1e-5, WD 5e-4 and clipping 0.1. Fit and holdout physical scenes are disjoint; evaluation order is asserted. Whole training rows must match the completed local control step by step. The 6887 pretrained-seen holdout and 9508 development validation remain separate.

The saved bbs/bbf selection matches the native token scores and is checked against native evaluator totals. GT is used for evaluation and offline oracle diagnostics, not to select the deployed prediction. Selected Query is fixed for coarse/final comparisons.

Launcher accepts only a nonblocking SOURCE_ONLY review, checks the completed predecessor, deploys one whole_range preflight and passes --mode preflight. Known host keys are loaded without an accept-unknown policy. Dynamic remote command arguments are quoted with shlex; the screen name is constant. No formal launch, process termination or weight deletion exists in these launch paths.

The observer performs a single quoted read of PID/status/exit/log information. The collector requires a terminated controller and a consistent complete/failed exit, enumerates only allowed text/source suffixes, checks environment and protected parent hashes, then verifies copied bytes. It neither downloads weights nor runs a model, changes a job or deletes anything. Hashing the parent weight occurs remotely without deserialization.

Both arms reference the actual new whole-range freeze-mode sanity, whose cached zero-head replay covers local/whole source equality. Formal launch checks the review reviewed_files list, requires the collected successful terminal probe, and rechecks remote completion and GPU availability. The controller checks the full B8/two-step/freeze/cached-pair/optimizer proof before either fit. The source does not substitute the historical joint-training preflight for this proof.

After each formal endpoint, the controller requires complete fixed-budget training and all 9508 rows, verifies row hash/order, recomputes selected-box threshold decisions on CPU, and verifies terminal and parent hashes. Selection uses strict native bbs @.50 improvement; ties keep the incumbent. Deletion is restricted to a named terminal.pth in one of the two owned arm directories, excluding the retained best and the protected original G. The runner overwrites one head-only recovery checkpoint and renames it to terminal; no full failed-weight archive is introduced.

scope_limitations: No actual tensor forward, backward, CUDA, AdamW step, checkpoint read, SSH query or experiment launch was performed by this reviewer. The new frozen-mode runtime checks remain pending.

Eval mode does not disable native F.gumbel_softmax (models.pv_ground.py:585-599). Frozen original state does not imply identical outputs across different RNG draws or processes. The paired zero-head preflight resets the RNG, and initial_range_comparison records actual differences instead of demanding cross-process bitwise equality.

The formal-pair launcher, controller and both specs were added during this review and have now been read. Their source gate is accepted, but the actual new-protocol preflight intake is absent. This report does not waive the real sanity requirement or certify any new fit/formal/retention execution.
The historical completed shared-training pair supplies source provenance and motivation only. Its training receipts show 806 changed tensors, so it cannot certify the new 10-tensor freeze protocol.
Source inspection and sentinel filtering do not constitute an actual empty-group AdamW runtime or serialized tensor replay. Those are explicitly exercised by the supplied two-step probe.
